set.body:
Scheduling lane: foundation. Current plan: docs/refactor/PLAN.md. Live dependency edges supersede historical sequencing below.

Current disposition, 2026-09-19; governing docs/refactor/PLAN.md.
Text compiler/model/codec/view parity pins are independent of the benchmark campaign and start now; retain approved S0 mutations.

Original scope retained below for evidence; fleet procedure/assignments are historical and do not govern single-developer work.

Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-18-best-recall-to-video-mapper.md §3 Phase 2 (Parity first); docs/plans/2026-09-17-d1a-source-to-story-plan.md §3 S0.

No golden pins compiler output. Every later D1A slice must leave these pins unchanged. (Sherlock per-unit anchor parity is pinned separately by the D1B-signatures ticket.)

Scope:
Test-only.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Pinned for the War of the Ghosts compile (JVM, pipeline): the compilation fingerprint, the candidateSet hex, StoryModelCodec.contentChecksum and the derivation.json checksum.
2. Pinned exemplars: one source-support/v2, one evidence/v2 and one mention-id rendering; the list of node orderings; one view artifact checksum.
3. The wog-record-1 receipts are pinned as receipt checksums (that record holds no model bytes).
4. Cross-platform model parity is cited from the fixtures goldens (not duplicated); JS/Native compile parity is stated as a non-claim.
5. Mutation witnesses each fail S0: one fixture span offset; emitting "anchors": null; changing the Text support encoding; changing a source-support/v2 span rendering.

Gate (AGENTS.md SD2/SD6): `sbt -batch clean compileAll testAll` on the merge result, then
`sbt -batch scalafmtCheckAll scalafmtSbtCheck` as a separate run; every test task in build.sbt's
testAll alias reports bound totals (56 at 0e36a7fa, after the corpus modules were added; recount if
modules change); a named mutation witness per new guard, and each compile-time-probe mutation proved
after its own clean recompile; `cd docs-site && npm run verify:examples` when public API or examples
change; fresh-context cold review in a separate pass; the commit body states the evidence and what
it does not establish.

Size: S.
set.title: [foundation] D1A-types S0: text parity baseline (compile, codec, view pins)
